notes: Captured from the help sandbox (~/owbn/_localwp-oat/help) after seed-cc-shots.php and seed-asc-shots.php: made-up roles and holders, sandbox-only keys. The plugin's screens are English-only, so the Portuguese pages reuse these images with Portuguese alt text.

alt.en: The Access Schema Role Registry: Add Role(s) with Full Role Path(s), then Registered Roles with each role's Name, Full Path and Depth, Edit and Delete.
alt.pt_BR: O Access Schema Role Registry: Add Role(s) com Full Role Path(s), e depois Registered Roles com Name, Full Path e Depth de cada cargo, Edit e Delete.

alt.en: A member's Access Schema Roles: two Assigned Roles, each with a remove button, and Add Roles to pick more.
alt.pt_BR: Os Access Schema Roles de um membro: dois Assigned Roles, cada um com um botão de remover, e Add Roles para escolher mais.

alt.en: The Users list with the ASC Roles column, the All ASC Roles menu, the Role pattern box and Filter.
alt.pt_BR: A lista Users com a coluna ASC Roles, o menu All ASC Roles, a caixa Role pattern e Filter.

alt.en: Access Schema Rules: Add Rule with Type, Trigger Pattern, Conflict Pattern and Description, and the Active Rules with one example rule.
alt.pt_BR: Access Schema Rules: Add Rule com Type, Trigger Pattern, Conflict Pattern e Description, e as Active Rules com uma regra de exemplo.

alt.en: Access Schema Settings: the API URL, the read-only and read-write keys with Generate New, logging, cache and the advanced switches.
alt.pt_BR: Access Schema Settings: a API URL, as chaves somente leitura e de leitura e escrita com Generate New, registro, cache e as opções avançadas.
